message.content:
The pronunciation of "doge" actually depends on which meaning you're referring to:

## 1. The Historical Italian Title (Venetian/Genoese ruler)

Pronounced: **/dəʊdʒ/** (UK) or **/doʊdʒ/** (US)

- Sounds like **"dohj"** (rhymes with "dodge")
- The 'o' is a long vowel sound like in "nose"
- The 'g' is a soft /dʒ/ sound like in "jump"
- This is the traditional pronunciation of the Italian title for the chief magistrate of Venice and Genoa

## 2. The Internet Meme/Cryptocurrency

There are **two competing pronunciations**:

- **/doʊdʒ/** ("dohj") — same as the historical title
- **/doʊʒ/** ("doh-zh") — with a soft French-style 'zh' sound like in "vision"

The meme (featuring the Shiba Inu dog) and the cryptocurrency (Dogecoin) have popularized both pronunciations. The creator of Dogecoin has reportedly said either is acceptable, though many in the crypto community use **/doʊʒ/** or even jokingly say **"dohj"**.

## Key Distinction

| Context | Pronunciation |
|--------|---------------|
| Historical Venetian ruler | /dəʊdʒ/ or /doʊdʒ/ ("dohj") |
| Meme/Shiba Inu | /doʊdʒ/ or /doʊʒ/ |
| Dogecoin cryptocurrency | /doʊdʒ/ or /doʊʒ/ (community uses both) |

The safest bet for the meme/crypto context is **/doʊdʒ/** ("dohj"), as it's the most widely recognized and matches the historical word's pronunciation.

Sources:
1. https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/doge
2. https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/doge
3. https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/doge
4. https://accenthero.com/app/pronunciation-practice/english/american/doge
5. https://memepediadankmemes.fandom.com/wiki/Doge
6. https://tieba.baidu.com/p/7611827332
7. https://pronouncebee.com/doge/
